adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Opportunistic infections, low CD4 cells, near-absent HLA-DR with preserved class I, and biallelic CIITA loss identify MHC II deficiency from failed MHC-II transcription.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: TAP affects MHC I, RAG affects antigen-receptor rearrangement, CD40L causes hyper-IgM, and AIRE affects central tolerance; none directly abolishes HLA-DR expression.
